<h2>Make Cross-Validation Branch Assignments</h2>

<h3>Description</h3>

<p>Reuses a shared pre-resolution assignment for a response-resolution branch
when coverage and balance remain valid, otherwise recalibrates that branch.
</p>


<h3>Usage</h3>

<pre><code class='language-R'>make_cross_validation_branch_assignments(
  data_locations = NULL,
  data_fold_resolution = NULL,
  data_shared_assignments = NULL,
  target_locations_per_cell = 5,
  grid_size_multipliers = 2^base::seq(-2, 2),
  n_repeats = 1L,
  occupancy_criterion = "median",
  lower_quantile_probability = 0.25,
  max_fold_location_difference = 1L,
  max_fold_sample_difference = Inf,
  seed = 900723L
)
</code></pre>


<h3>Arguments</h3>

<table role = "presentation">
<tr><td><code id="data_locations">data_locations</code></td>
<td>
<p>Branch location table returned by
[make_cross_validation_location_table()].</p>
</td></tr>
<tr><td><code id="data_fold_resolution">data_fold_resolution</code></td>
<td>
<p>One-row branch table returned by [resolve_cross_validation_fold_count()].</p>
</td></tr>
<tr><td><code id="data_shared_assignments">data_shared_assignments</code></td>
<td>
<p>Assignment table built from the shared pre-resolution sample universe.</p>
</td></tr>
<tr><td><code id="target_locations_per_cell">target_locations_per_cell</code>, <code id="grid_size_multipliers">grid_size_multipliers</code>, <code id="n_repeats">n_repeats</code></td>
<td>
<p>occupancy_criterion,lower_quantile_probability,
max_fold_location_difference,max_fold_sample_difference,seed
Grid-calibration and assignment controls used only when branch fallback is
required.</p>
</td></tr>
</table>


<h3>Value</h3>

<p>Assignment tibble with the stable assignment schema. 'assignment_source'
is '&quot;shared_pre_resolution&quot;', '&quot;branch_fallback&quot;', or
'&quot;branch_no_holdout&quot;'.
</p>


<h3>Examples</h3>

<pre><code class='language-R'>data_locations &lt;-
  tibble::tibble(
    location_id = base::letters[1:6],
    coord_x_km = base::seq_len(6L),
    coord_y_km = base::seq_len(6L),
    n_samples = base::rep(1L, 6L),
    row_indices = base::as.list(base::seq_len(6L))
  )
data_resolution &lt;-
  resolve_cross_validation_fold_count(6L, 5L)
data_shared &lt;-
  make_leave_one_location_out_assignments(data_locations)
make_cross_validation_branch_assignments(
  data_locations = data_locations,
  data_fold_resolution = data_resolution,
  data_shared_assignments = data_shared
)
</code></pre>
